heroSummary: Chandler Unified School District starts the 2027–28 school year on Wednesday, July 21, 2027. The calendar lists first intersession from September 27 through October 8, second intersession from December 20 through December 31, and third intersession from March 6–17. The last day of school is Thursday, May 25, 2028, with a half-day schedule.
calendarNotes: The CUSD 2027–28 calendar lists 180 student days and 190 teacher days. It keeps the modified calendar structure: teacher inservice/workdays before students return and after major intersessions, a two-week fall intersession, a winter intersession, a spring intersession, and junior high/high school early dismissals near semester and year-end grading periods.

sourceReviewDetails: We verified the first day, last day, intersessions, holidays, teacher inservice/workdays, junior high and high school early dismissals, and grading-period endings against the approved CUSD PDF.
The 2027–28 PDF does not list elementary parent-teacher conference dates in the same way as the 2026–27 revised calendar, so this page does not add a conference module for that year.
CUSD uses an intersession calendar. Families should check school-level announcements for campus-specific bell schedules and events.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Chandler Unified start school in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Chandler Unified starts the 2027–28 school year on Wednesday, July 21, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CUSD fall intersession in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The first intersession runs September 27 through October 8, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CUSD spring intersession in 2028?
Are CUSD teacher inservice/workdays student days?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Teacher inservice/workdays are no-school days for students.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for CUSD in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Thursday, May 25, 2028, with a half-day schedule.
